Strategic Midwest 3PL Account Executive
Mohawk Global · Middleburg Heights, OH, USA · 3 days ago
Job type: Full Time
Save JobApply on Company Site
Mohawk Global in the Midwest seeks an Account Executive with integrity and a drive for sales to identify and onboard new clients for our domestic 3PL services.
You will cultivate long-term partnerships, conduct meetings with potential clients, prepare proposals, and expand our client base across LTL/FTL, expedite and distribution.
This role emphasizes consultative selling, strong communication, and teamwork with internal stakeholders to deliver profitable, reliable transportation solutions.
